name: school-curriculum-coverage
coveragePolicy: A row is NOT marked complete merely because source links exist. Complete means each curricular textbook/material has a verified citation, classroom applicability, access route, and rights status.

statusDefinitions.LINKS_AVAILABLE: At least one indexed item/source link matches the grade/subject, but does not prove complete coverage.
statusDefinitions.NOT_PROVEN_COMPLETE: No proof that all required textbooks, workbooks, teacher guides, tasks and adaptations for this grade/subject are included.
statusDefinitions.VERIFIED_COMPLETE: Reserved for a checked full inventory reconciled against the official program and permitted source files; none automatically assigned.
